title: Shop-local date defaults and datetime-local conversion

baseline.head: e68cb65e61c5c1aab2ae169dd8033df305df8872
identifiedGaps: Report previous-month defaults used UTC month fields instead of the active shop calendar.
Journal effectiveDate started from a hard-coded historical date.
Shipment datetime-local input was interpreted in browser timezone while history used shop timezone.
baseline.excludedFalsePositive: Finance-entry create handler replaces its hidden initializer with the current ISO instant before opening; this path was left unchanged.
